plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp build for boxing with one focused S&C session each week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift, then Weeks 2-4 build power, basic strength, trunk work, and a small conditioning dose without creating too much fatigue for skill training. At the Week 4 checkpoint, review bar speed, recovery, and how well the session fits around boxing before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish a baseline and build general strength, power, and conditioning with simple repeatable work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power work while keeping the weekly dose recoverable beside boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen power and speed, and carry the work into cleaner sport-relevant output.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can and land softly. Full reset between reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and confidently.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use this session to establish your current baseline. Warm up with a few gradual sets, then perform one hard top set of 3-5 clean reps with strong depth and posture. Stop if form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your baseline for the next weeks.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if your goblet load is limited by the size of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve. Keep ribs down and move as one piece.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are not yet clean for the full rep range.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a neutral grip and pause briefly on the floor.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull the elbow toward the hip and keep the torso still. Smooth hard reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row

exercises.name: Front Plank

substitutionOptions.name: Body Saw Plank
